parameters.jsCode:
const articles = $json.articles; const userData = $json.userData || $json; const userName = userData.username || $json.username; const userId = userData.id || userData.user_id || $json.user_id; const newsletterId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 12); const unsubToken = Math.abs((userId + 'CHANGE_ME_SECRET_SALT').split('').reduce((a,b)=>{a=((a<<5)-a)+b.charCodeAt(0);return a&a},0)).toString(16); const feedbackBaseUrl = 'http://localhost:5678/webhook/feedback'; const feedbackLinkGood = `${feedbackBaseUrl}?uid=${userId}&token=${unsubToken}&newsletter_id=${newsletterId}&rating=good&feedback=good`; const feedbackLinkBad = `${feedbackBaseUrl}?uid=${userId}&token=${unsubToken}&newsletter_id=${newsletterId}&rating=bad&feedback=bad`; const date = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }); const articleCards = articles.map((a, i) => `

${a.source} | Article ${i+1}

${a.title}

${a.summary || a.description || ''}

Read the article →
`).join(''); const html = ` Persona Newsletter

Your personalised newsletter

Persona

${date}

Hello ${userName},

Here is your selection for today, chosen and summarised by an LLM based on your interests.

${articleCards}

You are receiving this email because you subscribed to Persona.

Unsubscribe  |  Change my preferences

Your opinion of this newsletter: I liked it  |  I did not like it

`; return [{ json: { html, subject: `Your Persona newsletter - ${date}`, email: $json.email, username: userName, user_id: userId, articles, newsletter_id: newsletterId } }];
